Spanish (es-ES): La obsesión de Alcina con un mundo ideal la llevó a crearme sin darse cuenta.

English: I possess some of her memories, as well as false memories belonging to her "ideal world."
Spanish (es-ES): Tengo algunos de sus recuerdos, además de recuerdos falsos que pertenecen a su "mundo ideal".

English: <speed=0.5><shake a=0.1>I...</shake><speed=1>I want to help you, Ruby.
There’s a missing part of our memory.
Spanish (es-ES): Hay una parte de nuestra memoria que falta.

English: Beneath the monastery lies something I can neither touch nor recall.
Spanish (es-ES): Debajo del monasterio hay algo que no puedo tocar ni recordar.

English: The link between it and the Pureblood Crystal might be the key to saving your friend.
Spanish (es-ES): La conexión entre eso y el Cristal de Sangre Pura podría ser la clave para salvar a tu amigo.

English: Take me there!
Let’s go!
Let's... take a short break...
Where are we?
We're in a special space created by Her.
Spanish (es-ES): Estamos en un espacio especial creado por Ella.

English: It’s made of illusion, but exists in the real world.
Spanish (es-ES): Está hecho de ilusión, pero existe en el mundo real.

English: She probably wants to keep us locked in here.
What's this weird talisman?
What do you have there?
It has some magical power, but I can't detect it fully...
Spanish (es-ES): Tiene algo de poder mágico, pero no logro detectarlo del todo...

English: Where did you find it?
It appeared out of nowhere...
Is that right? Could it be...?
Hmm...
Well it doesn't seem sinister. Maybe it could be useful as a talisman.
Spanish (es-ES): Bueno, no parece siniestro. Tal vez sirva como talismán.

English: Are you okay?
I'll be fine...
Ruby...
Before I met you, I existed in the ideal world within Her.
Spanish (es-ES): Antes de conocerte, yo existía en el mundo ideal dentro de Ella.

English: These memories might just be fabrications,
Spanish (es-ES): Puede que estos recuerdos sean solo invenciones,

English: but I nevertheless experienced them as if they were real.
Spanish (es-ES): pero aun así los viví como si fueran reales.

English: Her world might've been without pain or sorrow, but it was a boring world.
Spanish (es-ES): El mundo de Ella tal vez no tenía dolor ni tristeza, pero era un mundo aburrido.

English: As long as there exist people with different points of view, perfection is impossible.
Spanish (es-ES): Mientras existan personas con puntos de vista distintos, la perfección es imposible.

English: The price of perfection is a loss of self. No conflict, no rejection, no differences.
Spanish (es-ES): El precio de la perfección es perder la identidad propia. Sin conflicto, sin rechazo, sin diferencias.

English: Every trace of intent is erased.
Spanish (es-ES): Se borra todo rastro de voluntad.

English: ...I hate that kind of world.
Mira...
And just when I realized all this, I woke up in the monastery.
Spanish (es-ES): Y justo cuando me di cuenta de todo esto, desperté en el monasterio.

English: That’s when I met you.
It was the first time I made a friend like you.
Spanish (es-ES): Era la primera vez que hacía una amiga como tú.

English: I don't want you to live in such a souless world.
Spanish (es-ES): No quiero que vivas en un mundo tan sin alma.

English: We have to stop her.
Mmh.
I can help you leave this place.
Spanish (es-ES): Puedo ayudarte a salir de este lugar.

English: However...
I won't be able to maintain this form for much longer.
Spanish (es-ES): No voy a poder mantener esta forma por mucho más tiempo.

English: You’ll have to face Her on your own.
Spanish (es-ES): Vas a tener que enfrentarla a Ella tú sola.

English: No problem. I won’t lose.
Spanish (es-ES): No hay problema. No voy a perder.

English: Let’s go!
I believe in you!
Ruby, you’re finally awake.
Don't worry, you're out of Her control now.
Spanish (es-ES): Tranquila, ya estás fuera de Su control.

English: Everything in this White Space is real.
Spanish (es-ES): Todo en este Espacio Blanco es real.

English: Who are you?
I... don’t have a name...
My identity isn’t important.
You know me?
Of course, I’ve been watching you, Ruby.
Spanish (es-ES): Por supuesto, te he estado observando, Ruby.

English: B-but not as a creepy voyeur or anything...
Spanish (es-ES): P-pero no como una mirona rara ni nada de eso...

English: Where are we?
This is the White Space.
The gap between your dreams and an illusory plane.
Spanish (es-ES): El espacio entre tus sueños y un plano ilusorio.

English: In the real world, you’re still asleep.
Spanish (es-ES): En el mundo real, todavía estás dormida.

English: Illusory plane?
That’s right.
The illusory plane combines real-world parameters with illusion magic.
Spanish (es-ES): El plano ilusorio combina parámetros del mundo real con magia de ilusión.

English: Everything you experienced over this time period was an illusion.
Spanish (es-ES): Todo lo que viviste durante este tiempo fue una ilusión.

English: But what you experienced closely resembles what will soon happen in the real world.
Spanish (es-ES): Pero lo que viviste se parece mucho a lo que pronto va a pasar en el mundo real.

English: I don’t understand...
Haha... It is a bit complicated.
Spanish (es-ES): Jaja... Sí, es un poco complicado.

English: Who's "her"?
You refer to Her as the Witch.
Spanish (es-ES): Tú te refieres a Ella como la Bruja.

English: She’s the one behind this dream world and illusory plane.
Spanish (es-ES): Ella es quien está detrás de este mundo de sueños y del plano ilusorio.

English: Why would she do that?
This entire illusion exists for a single purpose...
Spanish (es-ES): Toda esta ilusión existe con un único propósito...

English: To trap you, Ruby.
She wants you to think that everything’s going according to plan.
Spanish (es-ES): Quiere que creas que todo está saliendo según lo planeado.

English: Defeating your enemies, reclaiming the kingdom, and achieving your happy ending.
Spanish (es-ES): Derrotar a tus enemigos, recuperar el reino, y conseguir tu final feliz.

English: Once you relinquish that last bit of doubt and accept the illusions, that’s when you lose yourself.
Spanish (es-ES): En cuanto abandones esa última duda y aceptes las ilusiones, ahí es cuando te pierdes a ti misma.

English: You’ll be forever trapped in that dream.
Spanish (es-ES): Quedarás atrapada en ese sueño para siempre.

English: Forever...
I tried several times to contact you, but it never worked.
Spanish (es-ES): Intenté contactarte varias veces, pero nunca funcionó.

English: Luckily, a flaw appeared in Her spell that allowed me to break the illusion.
Spanish (es-ES): Por suerte, apareció una falla en Su hechizo que me permitió romper la ilusión.

English: Thanks for helping me.
I... just can’t stand these phony illusions anymore, that’s all.
Spanish (es-ES): Yo... simplemente ya no soporto estas ilusiones falsas, eso es todo.

English: I want to get out of here.
Leaving already?
There's something I have to do.
Spanish (es-ES): Hay algo que tengo que hacer.

English: You may be able to defeat the Bloodstained in the illusory plane,
Spanish (es-ES): Puede que logres derrotar a los Ensangrentados en el plano ilusorio,

English: but the real world won’t be so forgiving.
Spanish (es-ES): pero el mundo real no será tan indulgente.

English: Your small size and fragility give you no margin for error.
Spanish (es-ES): Tu tamaño pequeño y tu fragilidad no te dejan margen de error.

English: She will not let you off the hook.
Spanish (es-ES): Ella no te va a dejar en paz.

English: You will die.
I won’t.
If that's what you want, I won't stop you.
Spanish (es-ES): Si eso es lo que quieres, no voy a detenerte.

English: No, it’s nothing.
Do you need something?
You know... no matter how far you walk, you won’t be able to leave...
Spanish (es-ES): ¿Sabes?... no importa cuánto camines, no vas a poder salir...

English: Ruby... you’re even weirder than I thought...
Spanish (es-ES): Ruby... eres incluso más rara de lo que pensaba...

English: Ruby, she...
Mom...
She's already become a Bloodstained.
Spanish (es-ES): Ya se convirtió en una Ensangrentada.

English: But that’s not all...
Something's approaching from behind her...
Spanish (es-ES): Algo se acerca detrás de ella...

English: It’s here, Ruby!
Mom?
Ruby...
It’s all okay now, Ruby.
You’ll soon be able to live happily together with your parents.
Spanish (es-ES): Pronto podrás vivir feliz junto a tus padres.

English: Your friends can also live the lives they desire.
Spanish (es-ES): Tus amigos también podrán vivir la vida que deseen.

English: This is the outcome you wanted, right?
Spanish (es-ES): Este es el resultado que querías, ¿verdad?

English: I will create a perfect world.
Spanish (es-ES): Voy a crear un mundo perfecto.

English: One without pain, hate or farewells.
Spanish (es-ES): Uno sin dolor, sin odio ni despedidas.

English: A world where everyone’s wishes can all come true.
Spanish (es-ES): Un mundo donde todos los deseos se puedan cumplir.

English: Make the right choice, Ruby.
Come, Ruby.
Your so-called ideal world is nothing more than your personal fantasy.
Spanish (es-ES): Tu supuesto mundo ideal no es más que una fantasía tuya.

English: I will never live in a world controlled by you!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Jamás voy a vivir en un mundo controlado por ti!

English: What a pity.
<size=150%>Watch out!
Unh...
Who... in the world are you...?
Again and again, you keep tearing my spells apart.
Spanish (es-ES): Una y otra vez, sigues destrozando mis hechizos.

English: Never mind. What you are doesn’t matter. I’ll...
Spanish (es-ES): No importa. Lo que seas no importa. Voy a...

English: ...What?!
What have you done?
Hah... I kicked her out for a bit...
Spanish (es-ES): Hah... La eché por un momento...

English: Y-your body...
It’ll be fine...
I just... need some rest...
Ruby, touch him now!
<speed=0.7>Well done, Ruby.</speed>
Roy.
Roy.
<size=150%><shake a=1>Roy!!!</shake>
L-Lily?
Are you listening to me...?
Or are you spacing out again?!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡¿O te volviste a quedar en las nubes?!

English: No... I was just...
I’m sorry, I was thinking about something else.
Spanish (es-ES): Perdón, estaba pensando en otra cosa.

English: You don't have to apologize for that. But anyway...
Spanish (es-ES): No hace falta que te disculpes por eso. Pero bueno...

English: <color=#525252>...why is there just bread and vegetable soup?
Spanish (es-ES): <color=#525252>...¿por qué solo hay pan y sopa de verduras?

English: Haven't you forgotten something important...?
Something important?
Surely you remember...
<speed=0.5>The all-important...
<size=150%><shake a=1>Marshmallows!</shake>
<speed=0.7>Ah...</speed><speed=0.8> Marshmallows.</speed>
We agreed to make marshmallows together today!
You haven't forgotten about it, right?
<color=#525252>Yeah... <wait=0.5> I really should've prepared more marshmallows.
You're acting strange today. You're nothing like your usual self.
Spanish (es-ES): Estás actuando raro hoy. No pareces tú para nada.

English: Normally, you’d say something like—
"Absolutely not! A runt like you needs a more balanced diet, blah, blah, blah..."
Spanish (es-ES): "¡De ninguna manera! Una mocosa como tú necesita una dieta más balanceada, bla, bla, bla..."

English: Honestly, I’m getting worried about you.
Spanish (es-ES): Sinceramente, me estoy empezando a preocupar por ti.

English: You’re always so distracted and absent-minded...
Spanish (es-ES): Siempre andas tan distraído y en las nubes...

English: But that’s okay, because you have me, a <wave>super reliable little sister</wave>!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Pero no importa, porque me tienes a mí, una <wave>hermanita súper confiable</wave>!

English: Everything will turn out just fine!
<speed=0.8>I’m sorry... </speed>Lily...
Everything will turn out just fine!
Hey, hey, hey. Weren’t you off to investigate the Witch?
Spanish (es-ES): Oye, oye, oye. ¿No que ibas a investigar a la Bruja?

English: Why’d you bring a kid back?
Gek! Or is she the <shake a=1>Witch</shake> herself?
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Gek! ¿O acaso ella es la <shake a=1>Bruja</shake> misma?

English: Knock it off, Wichiwi.
Change of plans. We’re staying here for a bit longer.
Spanish (es-ES): Cambio de planes. Nos quedaremos aquí un poco más.

English: What’s your name?
<speed=0.8>...</speed>
<speed=0.8>...R-Ruby...</speed>
<speed=0.8>Ruby </speed>Scarlet
Wait, <wait=1>did she just say Scarlet?
Can you stand up?
Don't forget, you still have unfinished business.
Spanish (es-ES): No olvides que aún tienes algo pendiente.

English: When the going gets tough, you must never hesitate.
Spanish (es-ES): Cuando las cosas se pongan difíciles, jamás debes dudar.

English: Make the most of every opportunity to attack.
Spanish (es-ES): Aprovecha al máximo cada oportunidad para atacar.

English: Let’s go!
Ugh...
Stand up, Ruby.
You know what to do.
Don't forget why you're here.
Spanish (es-ES): No olvides por qué estás aquí.

English: You have successfully defeated the Bloodstained of the Hallowed Rest.
Spanish (es-ES): Lograste derrotar al Ensangrentado del Descanso Sagrado.

English: You have successfully defeated the Bloodstained hiding in the Stagnant Sewers.
Spanish (es-ES): Lograste derrotar al Ensangrentado que se escondía en las Cloacas Estancadas.

English: All mana sources in Greenshroud Vale have been destroyed.
Spanish (es-ES): Se destruyeron todas las fuentes de maná del Valle del Velo Verde.

English: There's nothing left to investigate in the South. Only the North remains.
Spanish (es-ES): Ya no queda nada que investigar en el Sur. Solo falta el Norte.

English: You have successfully defeated the Bloodstained at Ashfrost Hamlet.
Spanish (es-ES): Lograste derrotar al Ensangrentado de la Aldea de Cenizahielo.

English: You have successfully defeated the Bloodstained hiding deep within Mount Ashfrost.
Spanish (es-ES): Lograste derrotar al Ensangrentado que se escondía en las profundidades del Monte Cenizahielo.

English: All mana sources on Mount Ashfrost have been destroyed.
Spanish (es-ES): Se destruyeron todas las fuentes de maná del Monte Cenizahielo.

English: There's nothing left to investigate in the North. Only the South remains.
Spanish (es-ES): Ya no queda nada que investigar en el Norte. Solo falta el Sur.

English: Was it that dream again?
Different?
Don't let those dreams get to you.
Spanish (es-ES): No dejes que esos sueños te afecten.

English: It felt different...
I can't quite remember...
Remember, you are no longer a helpless little girl, but a real hunter.
Spanish (es-ES): Recuerda, ya no eres una niña indefensa, sino una verdadera cazadora.

English: Let's begin your final test.
On the border of the Western Frontier lives a beast who has transformed into a Bloodstained.
Spanish (es-ES): En la frontera del Confín Occidental vive una bestia que se transformó en un Ensangrentado.

English: It blocks the only way to the Royal Capital. Your task is to take it out.
Spanish (es-ES): Bloquea el único camino hacia la Capital Real. Tu misión es eliminarla.

English: The Bloodstained's power can easily kill you. Never try to take any of their attacks head-on.
Spanish (es-ES): El poder de los Ensangrentados puede matarte fácilmente. Nunca intentes recibir sus ataques de frente.

English: Make good use of your agility to dodge every attack.
Spanish (es-ES): Usa bien tu agilidad para esquivar cada ataque.

English: This is the map.
Any questions before you leave?
About the Witch
Six months ago, Alcina the Witch invaded the Kingdom.
Spanish (es-ES): Hace seis meses, la Bruja Alcina invadió el Reino.

English: She had the singular goal of obtaining Pureblood Crystals.
Spanish (es-ES): Tenía un único objetivo: obtener Cristales de Sangre Pura.

English: The eyes of your people were the perfect material for creating the Crystals.
Spanish (es-ES): Los ojos de tu gente eran el material perfecto para crear los Cristales.

English: Listen, Ruby. Do not ever forget how she murdered all your friends and family.
Spanish (es-ES): Escucha, Ruby. Nunca olvides cómo asesinó a todos tus amigos y familiares.

English: She must be stopped. However, the lizard and I can't do it without your strength.
Spanish (es-ES): Hay que detenerla. Pero el lagarto y yo no podemos lograrlo sin tu fuerza.

English: About the Bloodstained
The Bloodstained are creatures that have been infected by Pureblood.
Spanish (es-ES): Los Ensangrentados son criaturas infectadas por la Sangre Pura.

English: By implanting Pureblood Crystals, the Witch can turn them into her puppets.
Spanish (es-ES): Al implantarles Cristales de Sangre Pura, la Bruja puede convertirlos en sus marionetas.

English: Shattering their embedded Pureblood Crystals is the only way to kill them.
Spanish (es-ES): Destrozar el Cristal de Sangre Pura que llevan dentro es la única forma de matarlos.

English: No, it’s nothing.
Make good use of your eyes. Destroying Pureblood Crystals is our key to victory.
Spanish (es-ES): Usa bien tus ojos. Destruir los Cristales de Sangre Pura es la clave de nuestra victoria.

English: Well done. You have completed the final training session. Get some well-deserved rest tonight.
Spanish (es-ES): Bien hecho. Completaste la sesión de entrenamiento final. Descansa bien esta noche, te lo mereces.

English: Ah, but before you do, take this bowl of soup down to the basement.
Spanish (es-ES): Ah, pero antes, lleva este tazón de sopa al sótano.

English: If he refuses again, just leave it there.
Spanish (es-ES): Si se niega de nuevo, solo déjalo ahí.

English: <talkVolume=0.4>The space that was hidden by magic has reappeared... We must find out how it was dispelled...</talkVolume>
Spanish (es-ES): <talkVolume=0.4>El espacio que estaba oculto por magia reapareció... Debemos averiguar cómo se disipó el hechizo...</talkVolume>

English: <talkVolume=0.4>If the same principle could be used on Pureblood Crystals...</talkVolume>
Spanish (es-ES): <talkVolume=0.4>Si se pudiera usar el mismo principio en los Cristales de Sangre Pura...</talkVolume>

English: Roy!
What’s the matter?
I'm hungry, I want to drink this soup.
Spanish (es-ES): Tengo hambre, quiero tomarme esta sopa.

English: No.
Take this bowl of soup down to the basement first.
Spanish (es-ES): Primero lleva este tazón de sopa al sótano.

English: Have you seen Wichiwi?
He's still inside the passage that appeared next to the Goddess Statue.
Spanish (es-ES): Sigue dentro del pasadizo que apareció junto a la Estatua de la Diosa.

English: It might not seem dangerous, but it has been affected by magic for a long, long time.
Spanish (es-ES): Puede que no parezca peligroso, pero ha estado bajo el efecto de la magia durante muchísimo tiempo.

English: Remember to pay close attention to your condition if you venture in.
Spanish (es-ES): Recuerda prestar mucha atención a tu estado si te aventuras ahí dentro.

English: Nothing.
Listen up, Ruby. We’ll soon be entering the Royal Capital.
Spanish (es-ES): Escucha, Ruby. Pronto entraremos a la Capital Real.

English: It's currently under complete lockdown.
Apart from the Royal Bridge, there is no other way into the city.
Spanish (es-ES): Aparte del Puente Real, no hay otra forma de entrar a la ciudad.

English: That means that we will likely encounter troublesome enemies.
Spanish (es-ES): Eso significa que probablemente nos encontremos con enemigos problemáticos.

English: Although, it's not all bad news. The bridge happens to be the fastest way into the city.
Spanish (es-ES): Aunque no todo son malas noticias. Resulta que el puente es la forma más rápida de entrar a la ciudad.

English: You must've collected quite a bit of Blood Dust from your battle with that Bloodstained yesterday.
Spanish (es-ES): Debiste haber conseguido bastante Polvo de Sangre en tu batalla de ayer contra ese Ensangrentado.

English: Don't forget to use it to augment your strength before setting off again.
Spanish (es-ES): No olvides usarlo para aumentar tu fuerza antes de partir de nuevo.

English: What’s the matter?
...You gave all your Blood Dust to Wichiwi?
Spanish (es-ES): ...¿Le diste todo tu Polvo de Sangre a Wichiwi?

English: <color=#525252>That sneaky lizard...
Here, you can have these.
Once you're ready, let’s go.
Any questions?
About the North
To the north of the Kingdom lies an active volcano: Mount Ashfrost.
Spanish (es-ES): Al norte del Reino se encuentra un volcán activo: el Monte Cenizahielo.

English: It’s named that because volcanic ash falls like snow all year round.
Spanish (es-ES): Se llama así porque la ceniza volcánica cae como nieve durante todo el año.

English: The Ashfrost Hamlet, a settlement at the foot of the volcano, is where one of the mana sources is located.
Spanish (es-ES): La Aldea de Cenizahielo, un asentamiento al pie del volcán, es donde se encuentra una de las fuentes de maná.

English:
It's said that they practice a religion that has nothing to do with the Goddess... 
Outsiders know very little about their beliefs.
Spanish (es-ES):
Se dice que practican una religión que no tiene nada que ver con la Diosa...
Los forasteros saben muy poco sobre sus creencias.

English: If you're heading north, you should start at the Ashfrost Hamlet.
Spanish (es-ES): Si vas hacia el norte, deberías empezar por la Aldea de Cenizahielo.

English: About the South
To the south of the Kingdom lies a swampy area called Greenshroud Vale.
Spanish (es-ES): Al sur del Reino se encuentra una zona pantanosa llamada el Valle del Velo Verde.

English: One of the mana sources can be found at the Hallowed Rest towards the end of the Vale.
Spanish (es-ES): Una de las fuentes de maná se encuentra en el Descanso Sagrado, al final del valle.

English: It was originally a quiet location. The city turned it into a cemetery where souls could rest in peace.
Spanish (es-ES): Originalmente era un lugar tranquilo. La ciudad lo convirtió en un cementerio donde las almas podían descansar en paz.

English: However, the plagues that have swept through the Vale over the years have made the Hallowed Rest a less than serene place...
Spanish (es-ES): Sin embargo, las plagas que han azotado el valle a lo largo de los años han hecho que el Descanso Sagrado ya no sea un lugar tan sereno...

English: If you’re heading South, definitely start at the Hallowed Rest.
Spanish (es-ES): Si vas hacia el sur, definitivamente empieza por el Descanso Sagrado.

English: No, it’s nothing.
Just let me know if you need anything.
Well done, Ruby.
If Wichiwi’s right about this, one of the seals on the city gates should be broken.
Spanish (es-ES): Si Wichiwi tiene razón sobre esto, uno de los sellos de las puertas de la ciudad debería haberse roto.

English: Get some well-deserved rest tonight.
Spanish (es-ES): Descansa bien esta noche, te lo mereces.

English: Mmh...
Believers of the Goddess have a custom of lighting candles at night.
Spanish (es-ES): Los creyentes de la Diosa tienen la costumbre de encender velas por la noche.

English: Illuminating the darkness was only one of the reasons.
Spanish (es-ES): Iluminar la oscuridad era solo una de las razones.

English: To the faithful, candlelight symbolizes light and hope.
Spanish (es-ES): Para los fieles, la luz de las velas simboliza luz y esperanza.

English: The flame is a prayer, and an appeal for guidance.
Spanish (es-ES): La llama es una plegaria, un pedido de guía.

English: When you’re feeling confused or uneasy, try lighting a few candles.
Spanish (es-ES): Cuando te sientas confundida o inquieta, intenta encender unas velas.

English: Do you pray too, Roy?
Rarely.
Frankly, I don’t think there’s a deity out there that would really lend me a hand.
Spanish (es-ES): Honestamente, no creo que exista una deidad que en verdad vaya a ayudarme.

English: However, candlelight does have a calming effect. That much is true.
Spanish (es-ES): Sin embargo, la luz de las velas sí tiene un efecto calmante. Eso sí es verdad.

English: Now, back to the topic at hand.
Another new hidden space appeared beyond the passage. You can get there by just walking straight ahead.
Spanish (es-ES): Apareció otro espacio oculto más allá del pasadizo. Puedes llegar caminando derecho.

English: It looks like a library, and Wichiwi is already inside investigating.
Spanish (es-ES): Parece una biblioteca, y Wichiwi ya está adentro investigando.

English: The magical barriers can’t just be sealing up empty space...
Spanish (es-ES): Las barreras mágicas no pueden estar sellando solo espacio vacío...

English: ...Something's being protected... or hidden, perhaps?
Something wrong?
There was a strange person last night...
A strange person?
I investigated the monastery this morning. There are no other entrances.
Spanish (es-ES): Investigué el monasterio esta mañana. No hay otras entradas.

English: According to Wichiwi, illusion magic and a seal were discovered inside yesterday.
Spanish (es-ES): Según Wichiwi, ayer se descubrió magia de ilusión y un sello ahí adentro.

English: What you saw may have been an illusion as well.
Spanish (es-ES): Puede que lo que viste también haya sido una ilusión.

English: Either way, you must focus on the mission for now.
Spanish (es-ES): De cualquier forma, por ahora debes concentrarte en la misión.

English: Okay.
...Nothing
There are currently <color=#fc2119>three</color> mana sources remaining. Let’s keep it up.
Spanish (es-ES): Actualmente quedan <color=#fc2119>tres</color> fuentes de maná. Sigamos así.

English: Any questions before you leave?
About the belfry
I went back to check the belfry last night.
Spanish (es-ES): Volví a revisar el campanario anoche.

English: That messy room is filled with books and notebooks, many of which are related to magic.
Spanish (es-ES): Ese cuarto desordenado está lleno de libros y cuadernos, muchos relacionados con la magia.

English: I’m almost certain that the Witch had once been there.
Spanish (es-ES): Estoy casi seguro de que la Bruja estuvo ahí alguna vez.

English: Why?

Magic is strictly forbidden in the Kingdom.
Possession of magic-related books is a severe crime, let alone using them.
Spanish (es-ES):
La magia está estrictamente prohibida en el Reino.
Poseer libros relacionados con la magia es un delito grave, y ni hablar de usarlos.

English:
To leave that material out in the open... 
Only she could be so brazen.
Spanish (es-ES):
Dejar ese material a la vista de todos... 
Solo ella podría ser tan descarada.

English: ...I must continue with my investigation.
No, it’s nothing.
Just let me know if you need anything.
I see you've successfully broken one of the seals on the city gate.
Spanish (es-ES): Veo que lograste romper uno de los sellos de la puerta de la ciudad.

English: Well done, Ruby.
If you're looking for Wichiwi, he's investigating the courtyard.
Spanish (es-ES): Si buscas a Wichiwi, está investigando el patio.

English: You can reach him faster through the passage to the right of the Goddess Statue.
Spanish (es-ES): Puedes llegar más rápido por el pasadizo a la derecha de la Estatua de la Diosa.

English: ...Sorry, I’m busy right now. Let’s talk later.
Spanish (es-ES): ...Perdón, ahora estoy ocupado. Hablemos más tarde.

English: There are currently <color=#fc2119>two</color> mana sources remaining. Let’s keep it up.
Spanish (es-ES): Actualmente quedan <color=#fc2119>dos</color> fuentes de maná. Sigamos así.

English: Any questions before you leave?
About the courtyard
Remember when I said possessing magic books was a serious crime?
Spanish (es-ES): ¿Recuerdas cuando dije que poseer libros de magia era un delito grave?

English: Yes.
The Kingdom usually disposes of contraband by burning it. The same goes for the criminals...
Spanish (es-ES): El Reino suele deshacerse del contrabando quemándolo. Lo mismo pasa con los criminales...

English: I investigated the remains of the burned books in the courtyard.
Spanish (es-ES): Investigué los restos de los libros quemados en el patio.

English: Their contents can't be fully restored, but pieces showed that the books were concerned with magic.
Spanish (es-ES): No se puede restaurar todo su contenido, pero algunos fragmentos mostraban que los libros trataban sobre magia.

English: Perhaps they can be used to dig up more information.
Spanish (es-ES): Tal vez sirvan para conseguir más información.

English: ...I must continue with my investigation.
No...
Anything related to magic is strictly illegal in your kingdom.
Spanish (es-ES): Todo lo relacionado con la magia es estrictamente ilegal en tu reino.

English: No, it’s nothing.
Just let me know if you need anything.
I see you've successfully broken one of the seals on the city gate.
Spanish (es-ES): Veo que lograste romper uno de los sellos de la puerta de la ciudad.

English: Well done, Ruby.
If you're looking for Wichiwi, he's investigating the corridor.
Spanish (es-ES): Si buscas a Wichiwi, está investigando el pasillo.

English: Go through the door behind me, and you'll find him at the back.
Spanish (es-ES): Cruza la puerta detrás de mí y lo encontrarás al fondo.

English: ...Sorry, I’m busy right now. Let’s talk later.
Spanish (es-ES): ...Perdón, ahora estoy ocupado. Hablemos más tarde.

English: There is currently <color=#fc2119>one</color> mana source remaining. Let’s keep it up.
Spanish (es-ES): Actualmente queda <color=#fc2119>una</color> fuente de maná. Sigamos así.

English: Any questions before you leave?
About the storage room
I took a look at that storage room.
Spanish (es-ES): Eché un vistazo a ese depósito.

English: There’s nothing unusual about it.
Spanish (es-ES): No tiene nada fuera de lo común.

English: I believe you, though. That labyrinth is in there somewhere.
Spanish (es-ES): Aun así, te creo. Ese laberinto está en algún lugar de ahí.

English: But if it really was an illusion, how was it able to distort space to such an extent?
Spanish (es-ES): Pero si de verdad era una ilusión, ¿cómo pudo distorsionar el espacio hasta ese punto?

English: This building hides too many secrets.
...I must continue with my investigation.
No, it’s nothing.
Just let me know if you need anything.
It seems you have successfully dealt with a mana source.
Spanish (es-ES): Parece que te encargaste con éxito de una fuente de maná.

English: Well done, Ruby.
If you're looking for Wichiwi, he's investigating the room in the corridor.
Spanish (es-ES): Si buscas a Wichiwi, está investigando el cuarto del pasillo.

English: You can get to him faster through that door next to me.
Spanish (es-ES): Puedes llegar a él más rápido por esa puerta a mi lado.

English: ...Sorry, I’m busy right now. Let’s talk later.
Spanish (es-ES): ...Perdón, ahora estoy ocupado. Hablemos más tarde.

English: It seems you have successfully dealt with a mana source.
Spanish (es-ES): Parece que te encargaste con éxito de una fuente de maná.

English: Well done, Ruby.
...Sorry, I’m busy right now. Let’s talk later.
Spanish (es-ES): ...Perdón, ahora estoy ocupado. Hablemos más tarde.

English: If you're looking for Wichiwi, he's investigating the new area.
Spanish (es-ES): Si buscas a Wichiwi, está investigando la nueva zona.

English: If you go through the door behind me, you’ll find him a the end of the hallway.
Spanish (es-ES): Si cruzas la puerta detrás de mí, lo encontrarás al final del pasillo.

English: Roy?
Roy!!!
Ruby?
...I didn’t notice you.
I see you've successfully broken one of the seals on the city gate.
Spanish (es-ES): Veo que lograste romper uno de los sellos de la puerta de la ciudad.

English: Well done.
...Sorry. I need to take a short break.
Anything else?
Talk about Wichiwi
Come to think of it, you've probably never seen lizardfolk before.
Spanish (es-ES): Pensándolo bien, seguramente nunca habías visto a un hombre lagarto antes.

English: Their appearance does look peculiar to some.
Spanish (es-ES): Para algunos, su aspecto resulta bastante peculiar.

English: According to Wichiwi himself, they’re a xenophobic, insular people.
Spanish (es-ES): Según el propio Wichiwi, son un pueblo xenófobo y cerrado.

English: They have a long history and have mastered many forms of magic.
Spanish (es-ES): Tienen una larga historia y dominan muchas formas de magia.

English: However, due to their isolation, most lizardfolk have never left their own realm.
Spanish (es-ES): Sin embargo, debido a su aislamiento, la mayoría de los hombres lagarto nunca han salido de su propio territorio.

English: It’s quite rare to see lizardfolk travelling around like he does.
Spanish (es-ES): Es bastante raro ver a un hombre lagarto viajando como lo hace él.

English: Also, don't be fooled by Wichiwi's carefree attitude...
Spanish (es-ES): Además, no te dejes engañar por la actitud despreocupada de Wichiwi...

English: He’ll still come through when it counts.
Spanish (es-ES): Cuando de verdad importa, siempre responde.

English: If you’re ever in a pinch, just ask him for help!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Si alguna vez estás en aprietos, solo pídele ayuda!

English: Talk about Roy’s cooking
Spanish (es-ES): Hablar sobre la cocina de Roy

English: Are you interested in cooking?
Yeah!
I used to not care for cooking.
Spanish (es-ES): Antes la cocina no me importaba nada.

English: Why?
<speed=0.4>Hmm...</speed>
As I mentioned before, I once had a younger sister.
Spanish (es-ES): Como mencioné antes, alguna vez tuve una hermana menor.

English: Our parents had passed away long ago.
Spanish (es-ES): Nuestros padres habían fallecido hacía mucho tiempo.

English: So we had to rely on each other to survive.
Spanish (es-ES): Así que tuvimos que apoyarnos el uno en el otro para sobrevivir.

English: Lily was quite the picky eater.
Spanish (es-ES): Lily era bastante quisquillosa para comer.

English: No carrots, no onions, no vegetables in general...
Spanish (es-ES): Nada de zanahorias, nada de cebollas, nada de verduras en general...

English: Though she never said no to dessert, of course...
Spanish (es-ES): Aunque, claro, nunca le decía que no a un postre...

English: So I started researching different dishes to try to change her eating habits.
Spanish (es-ES): Así que empecé a investigar distintos platillos para tratar de cambiar sus hábitos alimenticios.

English: Before I knew it, I had a bunch of dishes under my belt.
Spanish (es-ES): Sin darme cuenta, ya tenía un montón de platillos dominados.

English: <speed=0.4>Hmm...</speed>
Basically, if you want to learn to cook, don't overthink it.
Spanish (es-ES): Básicamente, si quieres aprender a cocinar, no le des tantas vueltas.

English: Taking the first step is what matters most.
Spanish (es-ES): Lo que más importa es dar el primer paso.

English: Now is not the time to go here.
Spanish (es-ES): No es el momento de ir ahí.

English: Now is not the time to rest.
Spanish (es-ES): No es el momento de descansar.

English: Looks like the door can't be opened from this side.
Spanish (es-ES): Parece que la puerta no se puede abrir desde este lado.

English: Open this door?
<color=#5E5E5E>It feels like someone's watching me...
There’s still more to investigate here.
Spanish (es-ES): Todavía hay más para investigar aquí.

English: Yo, kiddo!
Wichiwi, you explain.
No problem~
You remember seeing those eyes on the gate into the Royal Capital yesterday, right?
Spanish (es-ES): ¿Recuerdas esos ojos que viste ayer en la puerta de entrada a la Capital Real, verdad?

English: Well, they're a magical seal against Purebloods.
Spanish (es-ES): Bueno, son un sello mágico contra los de Sangre Pura.

English: The scent from Roy’s Pureblood Crystal allowed them to materialize.
Spanish (es-ES): El aroma del Cristal de Sangre Pura de Roy permitió que se materializaran.

English: Gek, on a side note, your people are really into organic building materials, haha.
Spanish (es-ES): Gek, por cierto, a tu gente sí que le gustan los materiales de construcción orgánicos, jaja.

English: Can you please be a bit more serious?
Spanish (es-ES): ¿Podrías ser un poco más serio, por favor?

English: Alright, sure.
According to my research, the true source of the seal is actually scattered across <color=#fc2119>four different mana sources to the north and south of the city</color>, where Bloodstained roam.
Spanish (es-ES): Según mi investigación, la verdadera fuente del sello está en realidad repartida entre <color=#fc2119>cuatro fuentes de maná distintas al norte y al sur de la ciudad</color>, donde merodean los Ensangrentados.

English: Basically, if you don't defeat the Bloodstained at those mana sources, you're not going through those gates.
Spanish (es-ES): Básicamente, si no derrotas a los Ensangrentados en esas fuentes de maná, no vas a poder cruzar esas puertas.

English: Is there another way in?
Gek, definitely not.
The Witch cast a barrier across the entire city. Her magic is completely impenetrable.
Spanish (es-ES): La Bruja lanzó una barrera sobre toda la ciudad. Su magia es completamente impenetrable.

English: Not a mouse nor even an ant could hope to burrow through it.
Spanish (es-ES): Ni un ratón ni siquiera una hormiga podrían esperar abrirse paso por ahí.

English: Our only option seems to be to investigate the mana sources.
Spanish (es-ES): Parece que nuestra única opción es investigar las fuentes de maná.

English: Ruby, you can reveal their Pureblood Crystals with your ability.
Spanish (es-ES): Ruby, tú puedes revelar sus Cristales de Sangre Pura con tu habilidad.

English: The task of defeating the Bloodstained can only be entrusted to you. Think you can handle it?
Spanish (es-ES): La tarea de derrotar a los Ensangrentados solo se te puede confiar a ti. ¿Crees que puedes con eso?

English: In the meantime, I will continue to investigate this monastery. Just let me know if you need anything.
Spanish (es-ES): Mientras tanto, voy a seguir investigando este monasterio. Avísame si necesitas algo.

English: A fugitive princess... You’re just like me, unable to let go.
Spanish (es-ES): Una princesa fugitiva... Eres igual a mí, incapaz de soltar el pasado.

English: Nothing will stop you, no matter what stands in your way.
Spanish (es-ES): Nada te detendrá, sin importar lo que se interponga en tu camino.

English: Since you so desperately want a different ending...
Spanish (es-ES): Ya que deseas con tanta desesperación un final distinto...

English: I shall grant your wish.
Fate will lead you here once more.
Spanish (es-ES): El destino te traerá de vuelta aquí una vez más.

English: Once you arrive...
I will pluck out your crimson eyes.
And finally, I will kill you with my own bare hands.
Spanish (es-ES): Y al final, te mataré con mis propias manos.

English: Enemies will sometimes leap into the air and unleash dangerous attacks that are <color=#fc2119>difficult to dodge</color>.
Spanish (es-ES): A veces los enemigos saltan al aire y desatan ataques peligrosos <color=#fc2119>difíciles de esquivar</color>.

English: That doesn't mean those attacks can't be countered, however.
Spanish (es-ES): Sin embargo, eso no significa que esos ataques no puedan contrarrestarse.

English: While the enemy is airborne, seize the opportunity to shoot a dart at them to disrupt their attack.
Spanish (es-ES): Mientras el enemigo esté en el aire, aprovecha para lanzarle un dardo y interrumpir su ataque.

English: During combat, there'll be times when you'll need to keep enemies at a distance.
Spanish (es-ES): Durante el combate, habrá veces en que necesitarás mantener a los enemigos a distancia.

English: Focus on an enemy from a distance to fire darts continuously.
Spanish (es-ES): Enfócate en un enemigo desde lejos para disparar dardos de forma continua.

English: You must be agile above all else. Your enemies will always wield far greater strength.
Spanish (es-ES): Ante todo, debes ser ágil. Tus enemigos siempre tendrán mucha más fuerza que tú.

English: Any attack could be fatal, so being able to dodge them is key.
Spanish (es-ES): Cualquier ataque puede ser fatal, así que saber esquivarlos es clave.

English: Go and show off your agility.
Well done. But as you've observed, your normal attacks will barely leave a scratch on your enemies.
Spanish (es-ES): Bien hecho. Pero, como ya notaste, tus ataques normales apenas van a rasguñar a tus enemigos.

English: The only way to truly take them down is to strike their Pureblood Crystal.
Spanish (es-ES): La única forma de derrotarlos de verdad es golpear su Cristal de Sangre Pura.

English: Use your eyes to <color=#fc2119>find the Crystal</color>, <color=#fc2119>and perform a Critical Strike</color>.
Spanish (es-ES): Usa tus ojos para <color=#fc2119>encontrar el Cristal</color> y <color=#fc2119>realizar un Golpe Crítico</color>.

English: You're getting the hang of it.
The Pureblood Crystal is only visible to your eyes.
Spanish (es-ES): El Cristal de Sangre Pura solo es visible para tus ojos.

English: By <color=#fc2119>precisely dodging</color> the enemy’s attacks, you’ll be able to exploit other openings.
Spanish (es-ES): Al <color=#fc2119>esquivar con precisión</color> los ataques del enemigo, podrás aprovechar otras aberturas.

English: You have already mastered the ability to defeat the Bloodstained.
Spanish (es-ES): Ya has dominado la habilidad para derrotar a los Ensangrentados.

English: Time to make use of all your skills to defeat your enemy.
Spanish (es-ES): Es hora de usar todas tus habilidades para derrotar al enemigo.

English: At times, enemies might attempt to <color=#fc2119>grab</color> you. Grabs can't easily be dodged with a simple roll.
Spanish (es-ES): A veces, los enemigos intentarán <color=#fc2119>agarrarte</color>. Los agarres no se esquivan fácilmente con una simple voltereta.

English: With complete focus, swing your blade and unleash the <color=#fc2119>Sunder Slash</color> to neutralize any grab.
Spanish (es-ES): Con total concentración, blande tu hoja y desata el <color=#fc2119>Tajo Desgarrador</color> para neutralizar cualquier agarre.

English: Can you still stand up?
Don't forget why you're here.
Spanish (es-ES): No olvides por qué estás aquí.

English: [Craft]
[Hand over damaged talisman]
It's gone... The Pureblood response in Roy's body is gone.
Spanish (es-ES): Desapareció... La respuesta de Sangre Pura en el cuerpo de Roy desapareció.

English: What exactly is going on?
Spanish (es-ES): ¿Qué es lo que está pasando exactamente?

English: Uh...
Uh-huh... Well at least he seems to be alright.
Spanish (es-ES): Ajá... Bueno, al menos parece estar bien.

English: Time’s running out, kid.
There's only less than an hour left until the full moon. You have to keep going.
Spanish (es-ES): Queda menos de una hora para la luna llena. Tienes que seguir.

English: I’ll take care of this guy.
Spanish (es-ES): Yo me encargo de este tipo.

English: Gek, so it really was an illusion.
Spanish (es-ES): Gek, así que sí era una ilusión.

English: But anyway, we've got a bigger problem right now.
Spanish (es-ES): Pero bueno, ahora tenemos un problema más grande.

English: Roy’s mana signature completely vanished.
Spanish (es-ES): La firma de maná de Roy desapareció por completo.

English: How do you know?
Uhh...
Let's not sweat the details. Either way, he's probably in trouble.
Spanish (es-ES): No te preocupes por los detalles. De cualquier forma, seguro está en problemas.

English: His last known location was near the walls of the Royal Capital.
Spanish (es-ES): Su última ubicación conocida fue cerca de las murallas de la Capital Real.

English: You should go investigate!
Gek, that’s the last of it.
Before we leave, we need to take all these valuables with us.
Spanish (es-ES): Antes de irnos, tenemos que llevarnos todas estas cosas de valor.

English: Gek, look at that troubled expression. I should do some explaining~
Spanish (es-ES): Gek, mira esa cara de preocupación. Debería explicarte algo~

English: What about that something I had to know?
Spanish (es-ES): ¿Qué era eso que tenía que saber?

English: Gek, look at that troubled expression. I should do some explaining~
Spanish (es-ES): Gek, mira esa cara de preocupación. Debería explicarte algo~

English: I <wait=0.5>know what the Witch is after!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Yo <wait=0.5>sé qué es lo que busca la Bruja!

English: Oh no! All the books downstairs have disappeared...
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Ay, no! Todos los libros de abajo desaparecieron...

English: <size=130%><shake a=0.2>Gek!</shake></size> What in blazes happened here?!
This is worse than that time when Roy got drunk at a tavern!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Esto es peor que aquella vez que Roy se emborrachó en una taberna!

English: Drunk?
Hmm... Gek, that’s besides the point.
Spanish (es-ES): Hmm... Gek, eso no viene al caso.

English: There seems to be a lot worth investigating here.
Spanish (es-ES): Parece que hay mucho que vale la pena investigar aquí.

English: It’s research time, gek!
Gek, we know the Witch is after the Rubinite.
Spanish (es-ES): Gek, sabemos que la Bruja busca la Rubinita.

English: But what does she plan to do with it?
Use it to save someone?
Gek, I thought of that possiblity.
Judging from the clues left behind in this monastery, the Witch may have desperately tried to save someone's life.
Spanish (es-ES): A juzgar por las pistas que dejó en este monasterio, la Bruja podría haber intentado desesperadamente salvarle la vida a alguien.

English: The Scarlet Kingdom has endured many plagues throughout its history.
Spanish (es-ES): El Reino Scarlet ha sufrido muchas plagas a lo largo de su historia.

English: The Rubinite might be the only solution to overcome an incurable disease.
Spanish (es-ES): La Rubinita podría ser la única solución para vencer una enfermedad incurable.

English: Gek...
Never mind, it doesn't matter.
C'mon, get packing already, kid!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Vamos, ponte a empacar de una vez, niña!

English: We need to leave early tomorrow and we’re not coming back.
Spanish (es-ES): Tenemos que salir temprano mañana y no vamos a volver.

English: Use it to get revenge?
Gek~ That makes sense.
The Scarlet Kingdom has a ban on magic stretching from antiquity. They even used to hunt down magic users.
Spanish (es-ES): El Reino Scarlet prohíbe la magia desde tiempos antiguos. Incluso solían perseguir a los usuarios de magia.

English: If someone was born with magical powers... they wouldn't be able to survive here.
Spanish (es-ES): Si alguien nacía con poderes mágicos... no podría sobrevivir aquí.

English: Does she want the Rubinite to seek revenge on an entire kingdom?
Spanish (es-ES): ¿Querrá la Rubinita para vengarse de un reino entero?

English: Why don’t we just send the brat in to take a look...
Spanish (es-ES): Por qué no mandamos a la mocosa a echar un vistazo...

English: <size=180%>Wichiwi!!!</size>
<size=150%>Gek!</size>
You!
You need to stop popping out of the blue like that!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Tienes que dejar de aparecer así de la nada!

English: Huff... Hah... Huff... Hah...
A-alright... I'll leave the investigating to you this time.
Spanish (es-ES): B-bien... Esta vez te dejo la investigación a ti.

English: N-n-not because I’m scared or anything!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡N-n-no es porque tenga miedo ni nada de eso!

English: Gek! You just sca- I mean, surprised me so much, I’m not in the mood to do any of this.
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Gek! Me asus- digo, me sorprendiste tanto que no tengo ganas de hacer nada de esto.

English: It's only fair to take responsibility for your actions, you know!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Es justo que te hagas responsable de tus acciones, sabes!

English: Go on. I-I'll be waiting for you!
Well, here's the new area, just up ahead...
Spanish (es-ES): Bueno, ahí está la nueva zona, justo más adelante...

English: It’s darker than I expected...
Spanish (es-ES): Está más oscuro de lo que esperaba...

English: Wichiwi.
<talkVolume=0.4>...</talkVolume>
This is such a pain...
Should I just grit my teeth and...
Wichiwi!
<talkVolume=0.4>...</talkVolume>
<talkVolume=0.4>Could this be...</talkVolume>
WICHIWI!
<size=150%><shake a=1><speed=2>Wah!? Gek!</speed></shake>
<size=150%><shake a=0.2>Cough </shake><size=100%>cough! Hmph, <shake a=0.2>it </shake>, it's you. Is it this late already?
Spanish (es-ES): <size=150%><shake a=0.2>Cof </shake><size=100%>cof! Hmph, <shake a=0.2>eres </shake>, eres tú. ¿Ya es tan tarde?

English: This strange passage suddenly appeared while you were out.
Spanish (es-ES): Este pasadizo extraño apareció de repente mientras no estabas.

English: I never expected this place to have secret hallways and rooms...
Spanish (es-ES): Nunca esperé que este lugar tuviera pasillos y cuartos secretos...

English: Something must've been deliberately hidden in this monastery.
Spanish (es-ES): Algo debe haberse ocultado a propósito en este monasterio.

English: I need to investigate this thoroughly, gek!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Tengo que investigar esto a fondo, gek!

English: <speed=0.2>...Hmm...</speed>

But in any case, this is as far as the passage goes right now,<talkVolume=0.3><size=60%><color=#7B7B7B> and this place feels rather eerie.<shake a=0.2> D-do you think there are ghosts here?</shake></color></talkVolume>
Spanish (es-ES): Pero, en fin, hasta aquí llega el pasadizo por ahora,<talkVolume=0.3><size=60%><color=#7B7B7B> y este lugar se siente bastante espeluznante.<shake a=0.2> ¿C-crees que haya fantasmas aquí?</shake></color></talkVolume>

English: Gek, I’m going back.
Gek. You sure took your time, kid.
Spanish (es-ES): Gek. Sí que te tardaste, niña.

English: Don’t just stand there! Help me move some of this!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡No te quedes ahí parada! ¡Ayúdame a mover algo de esto!

English: <talkVolume=0.4>This is...</talkVolume>
Wichiwi.
<talkVolume=0.4>...</talkVolume>
<talkVolume=0.4>But... It shouldn't...</talkVolume>
Wichiwi!!
<talkVolume=0.4>...</talkVolume>
<talkVolume=0.4>What kind of prankster would just leave a stack of blank paper here?</talkVolume>
Spanish (es-ES): <talkVolume=0.4>¿Qué clase de bromista dejaría una pila de papel en blanco aquí?</talkVolume>

English: <talkVolume=0.4>Gek!<shake a=0.2> Blank again?!</shake></talkVolume>
Wichiwi!
<talkVolume=0.4><shake a=0.2>Words... Pictures...</shake></talkVolume>
<shake a=0.2>Anything?<size=120%> There has to be some useful information here!</size></shake>
Spanish (es-ES): <shake a=0.2>¿Nada?<size=120%> ¡Tiene que haber información útil aquí!</size></shake>

English: Wichiwi!!!
<size=150%><shake a=0.2>Gwaaah!</shake></size>
<shake a=0.2>You...!</shake>
<shake a=0.2>You little brat! I've told you a million times not to scare people like that!</shake>
Spanish (es-ES): <shake a=0.2>¡Mocosa! ¡Te he dicho un millón de veces que no asustes a la gente así!</shake>

English: Sigh... Never mind...
What a letdown!
Every book I've looked through in here so far has been entirely blank!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Todos los libros que he revisado aquí están completamente en blanco!

English: A large library like this can't just be filled with empty volumes, surely...
Spanish (es-ES): Una biblioteca tan grande no puede estar llena solo de tomos vacíos, seguro...

English: Don't bother me right now, I need do some more digging.
Spanish (es-ES): No me molestes ahora, necesito seguir buscando.

English: <talkVolume=0.4>Where, oh where... can I find a normal book...</talkVolume>
Spanish (es-ES): <talkVolume=0.4>Dónde, ay dónde... encontraré un libro normal...</talkVolume>

English: <talkVolume=0.4>Blank...</talkVolume>
Wichiwi?
<talkVolume=0.4>Blank again...</talkVolume>
<speed=0.6><wave>Gek~ </wave>Moonlight shining upon the grass as a gentle breeze blows... <wave>How relaxing~</speed></wave>
Spanish (es-ES): <speed=0.6><wave>Gek~ </wave>La luz de la luna brillando sobre el pasto mientras sopla una brisa suave... <wave>Qué relajante~</speed></wave>

English: <speed=0.6>That stubborn Roy... Shame he never enjoys himself.</speed>
Spanish (es-ES): <speed=0.6>Ese Roy tan terco... Qué lástima que nunca se relaja.</speed>

English: <speed=0.6>And this place seems pretty spacious too, <wave>so we should be safe from illusion magic, right?</wave></speed>
Spanish (es-ES): <speed=0.6>Y este lugar parece bastante amplio también, <wave>así que deberíamos estar a salvo de la magia de ilusión, ¿no?</wave></speed>

English: <speed=0.5><wave>You should take a breather too, kid.</wave></speed>
Spanish (es-ES): <speed=0.5><wave>Tú también deberías tomarte un respiro, niña.</wave></speed>

English: Snore... Snooore...
<size=120%><shake a=1>Gek!?</shake></size> W-what's going on!?
Why is there a corpse here?! What’s with the flames?
Spanish (es-ES): ¡¿Por qué hay un cadáver aquí?! ¡¿Qué son esas llamas?!

English: <color=#525252><size=80%>Can illusion magic conceal temperature too?!</size></color>
Spanish (es-ES): <color=#525252><size=80%>¡¿La magia de ilusión también puede ocultar la temperatura?!</size></color>

English: These burnt remains look like...
Books?
Book burning! Books are the culmination of our ancestors’ wisdom! How could they have done this!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Quema de libros! ¡Los libros son la culminación de la sabiduría de nuestros ancestros! ¡¿Cómo pudieron hacer esto?!

English: Oh well, what’s done is done.
Spanish (es-ES): En fin, lo hecho, hecho está.

English: I’m leaving. I’ll come back in the morning to take a closer look.
Spanish (es-ES): Me voy. Vuelvo por la mañana a mirar más de cerca.

English: <color=#525252><size=80%>I... I don't want to stay here with that charred corpse...</size></color>
Spanish (es-ES): <color=#525252><size=80%>Yo... no quiero quedarme aquí con ese cadáver carbonizado...</size></color>

English: <size=150%><shake a=0.5>Gyaaaah!</shake></size><size=200%><shake a=1>Hot, hot, hot!</shake></size>
Let’s take another bite.
No flavor whatsoever.
Bizarre. This building should’ve been abandoned long ago.
Spanish (es-ES): Qué raro. Este edificio debería llevar mucho tiempo abandonado.

English: Yet this room remains spotless, as if it had just been lived in.
Spanish (es-ES): Y sin embargo, este cuarto sigue impecable, como si lo hubieran habitado hace poco.

English: <color=#7D7D7D>Is this entire space frozen at a certain point in time? Perhaps it's some kind of time freeze.</color>
Spanish (es-ES): <color=#7D7D7D>¿Estará todo este espacio congelado en cierto momento del tiempo? Tal vez sea algún tipo de congelamiento temporal.</color>

English: Wichiwi
The food on the table seems normal enough.
Spanish (es-ES): La comida en la mesa parece bastante normal.

English: <color=#7D7D7D>None of it has gone moldy or rancid. <speed=0.3>Maybe I should... </speed>give it a try?</color>
Spanish (es-ES): <color=#7D7D7D>Nada se enmoheció ni se echó a perder. <speed=0.3>Tal vez debería... </speed>¿probarla?</color>

English: Wichiwi!!!
<shake a=0.5><size=180%>Gek! Gwaaah!?</size></shake>
Hey you. Could you please call out to me more softly and gently from now on?<shake a=0.1></shake>
Spanish (es-ES): Oye. ¿Podrías, de ahora en más, llamarme de forma más suave y tranquila?<shake a=0.1></shake>

English: That food looks good.
It looks suspicious, more like. It could be a trap.
Spanish (es-ES): Más bien se ve sospechosa. Podría ser una trampa.

English: <speed=0.2>...</speed>
<speed=2><shake a=0.2>But I’m dying to know how it tastes!</shake></speed>
Spanish (es-ES): <speed=2><shake a=0.2>¡Pero me muero por saber a qué sabe!</shake></speed>

English: <speed=0.3>...</speed><speed=0.2>...</speed>
<size=150%>Let's do this. <shake a=0.2>One must develop a taste, quite literally, for the unknown to improve in magic.</size></shake>
Spanish (es-ES): <size=150%>Hagámoslo. <shake a=0.2>Hay que desarrollar el gusto, literalmente, por lo desconocido para mejorar en la magia.</size></shake>

English: <speed=0.2>...</speed>
<speed=0.5>Gek...</speed> It's got no flavor at all.
Gek... Should've known there's no such thing as a free lunch...
Spanish (es-ES): Gek... Debí saber que nada es gratis...

English: <shake a=0.5>Urk-</shake><shake a=0.8>urgggh...</shake>
<shake a=0.2>Cough, cough!</shake> Phew, <wave>much better.</wave>
This space was enveloped by some kind of <wave><size=120%>unknown spell</size></wave>.
Spanish (es-ES): Este espacio estaba envuelto en algún tipo de <wave><size=120%>hechizo desconocido</size></wave>.

English: Gek. Magic this intricate usually needs a core to maintain stability.
Spanish (es-ES): Gek. Una magia tan intrincada suele necesitar un núcleo para mantenerse estable.

English: It got deactivated out of the blue just now. Did you do anything?
Spanish (es-ES): Se desactivó de repente hace un momento. ¿Hiciste algo?

English: Well, those roses...
<speed=0.3>Flowers?</speed> Gek! That definitely looks unusual... and worthy of an investigation!
Spanish (es-ES): <speed=0.3>¿Flores?</speed> ¡Gek! Eso definitivamente se ve fuera de lo común... ¡y digno de investigación!

English: Gek, but before I do that...
I have some urgent business... to attend to...
Spanish (es-ES): Tengo un asunto urgente... que atender...

English: The situation isn’t good.
But you can't afford to stop now.
Spanish (es-ES): Pero no puedes darte el lujo de detenerte ahora.

English: There's only less than an hour left until the full moon. You have to keep going.
Spanish (es-ES): Queda menos de una hora para la luna llena. Tienes que seguir.

English: I'll stay behind here.
<size=150%><shake a=0.5>Gek! Fear not, Ruby! I’m here! Gek!!!</shake></size>
<size=105%><shake a=0.3><speed=0.5>...Gek? </speed></shake></size><speed=0.4>...</speed> Huh? I’m confused.
What were you doing in this tiny storage room this whole time?
Spanish (es-ES): ¿Qué estuviste haciendo todo este tiempo en este cuartito de depósito?

English: I kept calling out to you, but you never responded.
Spanish (es-ES): Te estuve llamando todo el tiempo, pero nunca respondiste.

English: Gek. I thought you were in danger.
Spanish (es-ES): Gek. Pensé que estabas en peligro.

English: Look, call this a huge labyrinth all you want...
Spanish (es-ES): Mira, llámalo laberinto gigante todo lo que quieras...

English: But far as I can tell, this just looks like an ordinary storage room.
Spanish (es-ES): Pero, por lo que veo, esto solo parece un depósito común y corriente.

English: Gek! You’re not trying to scare me, are you?
I’m telling the truth!
Even if you are, I don't see anything worth looking at in here.
Spanish (es-ES): Aunque sea así, no veo nada que valga la pena mirar aquí.

English: I’m going back now, gek!
Gek....
Stop swinging that knife around! It's dangerous!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Deja de agitar ese cuchillo por ahí! ¡Es peligroso!

English: Phew...
Got you all scared this time, didn’t I? Gekekek~
Spanish (es-ES): Te asusté bien esta vez, ¿eh? Gekekek~

English: Check out my Super Stealth Sneaky Invisibility Illusion Stealth Suit~
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Miren mi Súper Traje de Sigilo Furtivo de Invisibilidad e Ilusión Sigilosa~!

English: I wasn’t scared.
No use denying it! I saw the look of terror on your face~
Spanish (es-ES): ¡No sirve de nada negarlo! Vi el terror en tu cara~

English: Over the last few days, I've been sampling and analyzing the illusion magic in these spaces.
Spanish (es-ES): En estos últimos días, estuve tomando muestras y analizando la magia de ilusión de estos espacios.

English: And what you just witnessed was the fruit of my labor—the successful integration of illusion magic into a talisman.
Spanish (es-ES): Y lo que acabas de presenciar fue el fruto de mi trabajo: la integración exitosa de la magia de ilusión en un talismán.

English: While it can't create the same level of illusion, it will allow its user to stay invisible~
Spanish (es-ES): Aunque no puede crear el mismo nivel de ilusión, permite que quien lo use se mantenga invisible~

English: Right, time to continue with my research here~
Spanish (es-ES): Bien, hora de seguir con mi investigación aquí~

English: You said "stealth" twice.
Ah~ Let’s not get caught up in the details.
Spanish (es-ES): Ah~ No nos enfoquemos en los detalles.

English: <size=110%>Gyaaaah!</size>
<size=110%><shake a=0.001>C-calm down! It's me!</shake></size>
Looks like this place was the office of some big shot.
Spanish (es-ES): Parece que este lugar era la oficina de algún pez gordo.

English: There's not a worthwhile book to be found here.
Spanish (es-ES): No hay ningún libro que valga la pena por aquí.

English: Gyaaaaah?!
M-My word... A headless corpse!?
Spanish (es-ES): P-por todos los... ¡¿un cadáver sin cabeza?!

English: This feels wrong... Something’s really off about this place.
Spanish (es-ES): Esto se siente mal... Hay algo realmente raro con este lugar.

English: ...I don’t see anything worth investigating...
Spanish (es-ES): ...No veo nada que valga la pena investigar...

English: I... can't stay here any longer... S-see you later!
Spanish (es-ES): Yo... no puedo quedarme aquí más tiempo... ¡N-nos vemos luego!

English: Everything’s pretty much packed up.
Once you’re ready, let’s go.
Gek. You leaving?
Here, this is for you.
This is a—
Talisman Satchel?
You know your stuff, huh?
I've already put a few talismans inside.
Gek, there's plenty of good stuff in there, so take care of it.
Spanish (es-ES): Gek, ahí adentro hay cosas bastante buenas, así que cuídala.

English: It’s a talisman. Take it with you.
It's not exactly a rare artifact, but it should give you slightly more of a fighting chance. Gek~
Spanish (es-ES): No es exactamente un artefacto raro, pero debería darte un poco más de ventaja en la pelea. Gek~

English: <speed=0.4>Hehe...</speed> Since you accepted my gift, the proper thing would be to do me a favor, right? Gekeke~
Spanish (es-ES): <speed=0.4>Jeje...</speed> Ya que aceptaste mi regalo, lo correcto sería hacerme un favor, ¿no? Gekeke~

English: If you can help me collect <color=#fc2119>Blood Dust</color> or other <color=#fc2119>special items</color>, I can help you craft more equipment.
Spanish (es-ES): Si me ayudas a conseguir <color=#fc2119>Polvo de Sangre</color> u otros <color=#fc2119>objetos especiales</color>, puedo ayudarte a fabricar más equipo.

English: Like Healing Potions?
Kid, are you still half-asleep? No item's that convenient.
Spanish (es-ES): Niña, ¿todavía estás medio dormida? Ningún objeto es tan conveniente.

English: Want to see what I can make?
Sounds like a great deal, doesn’t it? Don’t you want to see what I can make?
Spanish (es-ES): Suena a un buen trato, ¿no? ¿No quieres ver qué puedo fabricar?

English: Sure.
Well, if you come across any <color=#fc2119>Blood Dust</color> or <color=#fc2119>special item</color>, you can bring it to me.
Spanish (es-ES): Bueno, si encuentras <color=#fc2119>Polvo de Sangre</color> o algún <color=#fc2119>objeto especial</color>, puedes traérmelo.

English: I’ll make it worth your while, Gek.
Spanish (es-ES): Va a valer la pena, Gek.

English: No
Leaving already?
You guys go ahead, don't worry about me.
Spanish (es-ES): Vayan ustedes, no se preocupen por mí.

English: We’ll leave the housekeeping to you.
Spanish (es-ES): Te dejamos a ti las tareas de la casa.

English: W-what do you take me for!?
Let's go together?
Do I look like a fighter to you!? Gek!
W-what else do you want?
<shake a=0.1>Uh...</shake>
<shake a=0.2>Gek... Gek...!!</shake> Seriously, how is this guy so heavy!?
Spanish (es-ES): <shake a=0.2>Gek... ¡¡Gek...!!</shake> En serio, ¡¿cómo puede pesar tanto este tipo?!

English: Right, a couple stitches here<speed=0.2>...</speed> Patch things up here<speed=0.2>...</speed>
Spanish (es-ES): Bien, un par de puntos aquí<speed=0.2>...</speed> Arreglo esto aquí<speed=0.2>...</speed>

English: Gek! That’s that arm taken care of!
Is Roy... going to die?
Hmm... Don’t be fooled by his thoughtful demeanor, kid.
Spanish (es-ES): Hmm... No te dejes engañar por su aire reflexivo, niña.

English: When things come down to the wire, he can be an impulsive fool.
Spanish (es-ES): Cuando las cosas se ponen difíciles, puede ser un tonto impulsivo.

English: Gekeke~ Don't worry, it takes a lot more than that to finish him.
Spanish (es-ES): Gekeke~ Tranquila, hace falta mucho más que eso para acabar con él.

English: R-really?
Even if he tries to end himself, the <color=#fc2119>Pureblood Crystal</color> won't allow him to die.
Spanish (es-ES): Aunque intente acabar con su propia vida, el <color=#fc2119>Cristal de Sangre Pura</color> no lo va a dejar morir.

English: Well, if you come across any <color=#fc2119>Blood Dust</color> or <color=#fc2119>special item</color>, you can bring it to me.
Spanish (es-ES): Bueno, si encuentras <color=#fc2119>Polvo de Sangre</color> o algún <color=#fc2119>objeto especial</color>, puedes traérmelo.

English: I’ll make it worth your while, Gek.
Spanish (es-ES): Va a valer la pena, Gek.

English: That bell is way too loud...
<shake a=0.2>Gek... My ears...</shake>
W-what else do you want?
I discovered tons of incredible information inside the belfry.
Spanish (es-ES): Descubrí una tonelada de información increíble dentro del campanario.

English: But before I tell you what I learned, I'd like to ask if you encountered anything strange during your investigation these past few days.
Spanish (es-ES): Pero antes de contarte lo que aprendí, quiero preguntarte si encontraste algo extraño durante tu investigación estos últimos días.

English: Strange images
...I knew it.
The room that was unsealed was actually hidden under an ancient illusion spell.
Spanish (es-ES): El cuarto que se desselló en realidad estaba oculto bajo un antiguo hechizo de ilusión.

English: If the texts are correct, magic like that is made by projecting memories to build the illusion.
Spanish (es-ES): Si los textos son correctos, ese tipo de magia se hace proyectando recuerdos para construir la ilusión.

English: You must've brushed against the core without realizing and destroyed the illusion.
Spanish (es-ES): Debiste haber rozado el núcleo sin darte cuenta y destruiste la ilusión.

English: Whoever cast such a sophisticated spell clearly didn't want anyone to see the room as it truly is.
Spanish (es-ES): Quien haya lanzado un hechizo tan sofisticado claramente no quería que nadie viera el cuarto tal como es en verdad.

English: What else did you see in that memory?
I don't remember.
Gek, was it like a dream, hard to remember once you wake up?
Spanish (es-ES): Gek, ¿fue como un sueño, difícil de recordar una vez que despiertas?

English: Hmm... In any case—

This is fascinating! Wow!
I've never seen this kind of spell before!
Spanish (es-ES):
¡Esto es fascinante! ¡Guau!
¡Nunca había visto este tipo de hechizo!

English: I must perform more research!
Blurry people
A lizard with an upset stomach
Spanish (es-ES): Un lagarto con dolor de panza

English: ...I knew i-
Gek! Stop joking around! I'm making a serious point here!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Gek! ¡Deja de bromear! ¡Estoy diciendo algo en serio!

English: Strange images
Blurry people
My back is still hurting...
Oh, heavens... Why am I always on the receiving end of these misfortunes?
Spanish (es-ES): Ay, por favor... ¿Por qué siempre me toca a mí sufrir estas desgracias?

English: Gek. You leaving?
I tell you, the illusion magic inside this monastery is deeply intriguing!
Spanish (es-ES): Te digo, ¡la magia de ilusión de este monasterio es sumamente fascinante!

English: Just imagine it...
The ability to look stronger, taller or more charismatic. You could change color or even become invisible!
Spanish (es-ES): La capacidad de verte más fuerte, más alta o más carismática. ¡Podrías cambiar de color o hasta volverte invisible!

English: I’d like to grow taller...
Spanish (es-ES): A mí me gustaría crecer más...

English: That's the spirit!
I’ll let you know as soon as I find a way, little one! Gekeke~
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Te aviso en cuanto encuentre la forma, pequeña! Gekeke~

English: Invisibility...
You've got another thing coming if you dare use it to scare me, you little brat!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Te vas a llevar una sorpresa si te atreves a usarla para asustarme, mocosa!

English: Gek, well, time to get researching!
Can't you see I’m in the middle of something, kid?
Spanish (es-ES): ¿No ves que estoy en medio de algo, niña?

English: I just need to carve the corresponding rune...
Spanish (es-ES): Solo necesito grabar la runa correspondiente...

English: <size=80%>...</size>
I don’t know where Roy went.
Spanish (es-ES): No sé a dónde fue Roy.

English: But never mind him. My detection results show that the mana sources associated with the city gates have dissipated.
Spanish (es-ES): Pero olvídate de él. Mis resultados de detección muestran que las fuentes de maná asociadas con las puertas de la ciudad se disiparon.

English: Therefore, the seal should be lifted.
Spanish (es-ES): Por lo tanto, el sello debería haberse levantado.

English: Stop wasting time here and get investigating!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Deja de perder el tiempo aquí y ve a investigar!

English: Gek, you’re finally awake, kid.
The gates to the Royal Capital are open.
Spanish (es-ES): Las puertas de la Capital Real están abiertas.

English: Roy brought you home, then went right back to the Royal Capital.
Spanish (es-ES): Roy te trajo a casa, y después volvió enseguida a la Capital Real.

English: You were unconscious for two whole days.
I can’t believe he made me babysit for...
Spanish (es-ES): No puedo creer que me hizo de niñera durante...

English: Gek, never mind! I have some new findings concerning the Pureblood Crystal, but I'll need a bit more time to verify them.
Spanish (es-ES): Gek, ¡da igual! Tengo algunos hallazgos nuevos sobre el Cristal de Sangre Pura, pero necesito un poco más de tiempo para confirmarlos.

English: New areas have opened up, but I wasn’t able to find any useful information.
Spanish (es-ES): Se abrieron nuevas zonas, pero no pude encontrar información útil.

English: Based on previous experiences, it’s likely that they've also been altered by illusion magic.
Spanish (es-ES): Basándome en experiencias anteriores, es probable que también hayan sido alteradas por magia de ilusión.

English: Gek, I’m helpless against those illusions. You should go poke around~
Spanish (es-ES): Gek, yo no puedo hacer nada contra esas ilusiones. Deberías ir a curiosear~

English: If there’s nothing else to do, you should get some rest, kid.
Spanish (es-ES): Si no hay nada más que hacer, deberías descansar, niña.

English: What do you want?
<wave>Gek! Did you find something new?</wave>
Gek?<shake a=0.1> You came to me empty-handed?!</shake>
Hand over the damaged white talisman
This is... a broken talisman?
Folks in the past thought talismans were just good luck charms that also demonstrated your faith.
Spanish (es-ES): La gente de antes pensaba que los talismanes eran solo amuletos de la suerte que además demostraban tu fe.

English: What they didn't know is that talismans are actually sophisticated magical objects!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Lo que no sabían es que los talismanes en realidad son objetos mágicos sofisticados!

English: Gek! You're in luck, because I’m <wave>the best talisman craftsman in the world</wave>!
Spanish (es-ES): ¡Gek! Estás de suerte, porque soy <wave>el mejor artesano de talismanes del mundo</wave>!

English: <speed=0.2>...</speed>
Okay, the best in my country.
Spanish (es-ES): Bueno, el mejor de mi país.

English: <speed=0.2>...</speed>
Oh fine, fine. I was the best in my home town. <shake a=0.2>Now stop giving me that look! Gek!
Spanish (es-ES): Ay, está bien, está bien. Era el mejor de mi pueblo. <shake a=0.2>¡Deja de mirarme así! ¡Gek!

English: Anyways, with this, I can make more talismans for you.
Spanish (es-ES): Bueno, con esto puedo fabricarte más talismanes.

English: If you find any more, you can bring them to me.
With this, I can make more talismans for you.
Spanish (es-ES): Con esto puedo fabricarte más talismanes.

English: Hand over the damaged orange talisman
Hand over the damaged yellow talisman
Hand over the damaged blue talisman
Hand over the damaged green talisman
Hand over the damaged purple talisman
Hand over the damaged red talisman
To understand the Witch, we must start from the very beginning.
Spanish (es-ES): Para entender a la Bruja, hay que empezar desde el principio.

English: House Scarlet possessed a unique bloodline, that of the Pureblood.
Spanish (es-ES): La Casa Scarlet poseía un linaje único: el de la Sangre Pura.

English: It bestowed upon your people powerful magic.
Spanish (es-ES): Eso le dio a tu gente una magia poderosa.

English: It also grants you your blood-red eyes.
Spanish (es-ES): También es lo que te da esos ojos rojo sangre.

English: You drew them in white, though.
I know, just pretend for a bit~
Spanish (es-ES): Lo sé, solo finge un rato~

English: I only have white chalk to work with, gek.
Spanish (es-ES): Solo tengo tiza blanca para trabajar, gek.

English: I have red chalk!
Gek... Fine. Now it feels more immersive.
Spanish (es-ES): Gek... Está bien. Ahora se siente más inmersivo.

English: The Witch used the eyes of your people to extract Pureblood Crystals.
Spanish (es-ES): La Bruja usaba los ojos de tu gente para extraer Cristales de Sangre Pura.

English: The strength of the Crystals are directly related to blood purity.
Spanish (es-ES): La fuerza de los Cristales está directamente relacionada con la pureza de la sangre.

English: That makes direct bloodlines like yours and the King's perfect for this procedure.
Spanish (es-ES): Eso hace que los linajes directos, como el tuyo y el del Rey, sean perfectos para este procedimiento.

English: <color=#9d9d9d><size=90%>...Father...</size></color>
There was one thing I was confused about, though.
Spanish (es-ES): Aunque había algo que no terminaba de entender.

English: The strength of the resulting Crystals shouldn't be that different between direct and indirect bloodlines.
Spanish (es-ES): La fuerza de los Cristales resultantes no debería variar tanto entre linajes directos e indirectos.

English: I figured that if the Witch was only after the Crystals, there'd be no need for her to go to such lengths.
Spanish (es-ES): Pensé que si la Bruja solo buscaba los Cristales, no tendría por qué tomarse tantas molestias.

English: ...That was, until I discovered a long-forgotten legend in the belfry.
Spanish (es-ES): ...Eso fue hasta que descubrí una leyenda olvidada hace mucho en el campanario.

English: The legend tells of how the goddess Scarlet created a gemstone called the Rubinite.
Spanish (es-ES): La leyenda cuenta cómo la diosa Scarlet creó una gema llamada la Rubinita.

English: It held limitless power that bestowed fertility onto the land, drew people together, and gave rise to a kingdom.
Spanish (es-ES): Poseía un poder ilimitado que le dio fertilidad a la tierra, unió a la gente y dio origen a un reino.

English: To keep the Rubinite out of wicked hands, the goddess sealed it inside a mortal vessel.
Spanish (es-ES): Para mantener la Rubinita lejos de manos malvadas, la diosa la selló dentro de un recipiente mortal.

English: That person was known as the "True Vessel," the founder of the Scarlet Kingdom. You are one of his descendants.
Spanish (es-ES): Esa persona fue conocida como el "Verdadero Recipiente", el fundador del Reino Scarlet. Tú eres una de sus descendientes.

English: If this legend is true, then the Witch isn’t after your eyes, nor the Crystals.
Spanish (es-ES): Si esta leyenda es cierta, entonces la Bruja no busca tus ojos, ni los Cristales.

English: She's after the Rubinite.
From what I've read of research notes scattered across the land,
Spanish (es-ES): Por lo que leí en notas de investigación esparcidas por toda la tierra,

English: the moon is the source of Scarlet's power, while the Rubinite draws power from the Blood Moon.
Spanish (es-ES): la luna es la fuente del poder de Scarlet, mientras que la Rubinita saca su poder de la Luna de Sangre.

English: Blood Moon?
Correct, gek.
Every few centuries, a crimson full moon rises to the skies.
Spanish (es-ES): Cada pocos siglos, una luna llena carmesí se alza en el cielo.

English: If a powerful Pureblood Crystal is bathed in its light,
Spanish (es-ES): Si un Cristal de Sangre Pura poderoso se baña en su luz,

English: it will transform into true Rubinite,
Spanish (es-ES): se transforma en la verdadera Rubinita,

English: granting the Witch limitless power.
Spanish (es-ES): otorgándole a la Bruja un poder ilimitado.

English: That would spell the end for not only the Scarlet Kingdom, but the entire world.

Ancient Sorcerer’s Notebook 1: 

I have traversed far and wide and have seen countless artifacts. Even so, my first encounter with the blood-red eyes of the Scarlet Crown Prince was an extraordinary experience. For these revered Purebloods, what secrets lie hidden behind those crimson eyes...?

One day, I mistakenly killed a courtier and plucked his eyes. I shouldn’t have acted the way I did, but the more I studied the eyes, the more obsessed I became.
I refined the Pureblood’s eyes into an extremely powerful gem. However, this could not end here. If I could obtain an even purer specimen... Those of the Crown Prince or even the King's eyes...

In the end, I killed the King, and absconded to the frontier with his eyes.

Cuaderno del Hechicero Antiguo 1: 

He recorrido tierras lejanas y he visto incontables artefactos. Aun así, mi primer encuentro con los ojos rojo sangre del Príncipe Escarlata fue una experiencia extraordinaria. Para estos venerados Sangre Pura, ¿qué secretos se esconden tras esos ojos carmesí...?

Un día, maté por error a un cortesano y le arranqué los ojos. No debí actuar como lo hice, pero cuanto más estudiaba los ojos, más obsesionado me volvía.
Refiné los ojos del Sangre Pura hasta convertirlos en una gema extremadamente poderosa. Sin embargo, esto no podía terminar aquí. Si pudiera obtener un espécimen aún más puro... Los del Príncipe Heredero, o incluso los ojos del Rey...

Al final, maté al Rey y hui a la frontera con sus ojos.

English: Ancient Sorcerer’s Notebook 1

Ancient Sorcerer's Notebook 2:

At first, I was disappointed. The gem crafted from the king's eyes was as ordinary and unremarkable as any other Pureblood Crystal. However, as I gazed upon it, the memory of an ancient legend welled up within me: the Blood Moon. If the legend is true, this gem will undergo a transformation when the full moon rises...

I cannot wait a moment longer. I must use the gem...

No puedo esperar ni un momento más. Debo usar la gema...

Scribbled Notes:
Illusion magic is an ancient art that alters the appearance of things through construction and fabrication.
The more information incorporated, the more realistic the illusion will be. That information can come from the object's inherent qualities, like its size and color, to the caster's own understanding.

To create large-scale illusions, the caster’s memory is the best material, but it requires a higher level of magical power. An illusion can be visually flawless, but it cannot be imbued with meaning. It is, ultimately, a false existence.

Notas Garabateadas:
La magia de ilusión es un arte antiguo que altera la apariencia de las cosas mediante construcción y fabricación.
Cuanta más información se incorpore, más realista será la ilusión. Esa información puede provenir de las cualidades inherentes del objeto, como su tamaño y color, hasta el propio entendimiento del conjurador.

Para crear ilusiones a gran escala, la memoria del conjurador es el mejor material, pero requiere un nivel más alto de poder mágico. Una ilusión puede ser visualmente impecable, pero no se le puede infundir significado. Es, en última instancia, una existencia falsa.

▪▪▪.▪▪.▪▪
Alcina has magical powers. Magic may be illegal, but our curiosity drives us to experiment.
Every midnight, we hide in the belfry, studying forbidden texts.
